sloka: उपाध्याय गणाः सर्वे यजमानम् अथ अब्रुवन् ।अयम् पर्वणि वेगेन यज्ञिय अश्वो अपनीयते ॥१-३९-८॥
transliteration: upādhyāya gaṇāḥ sarve yajamānam atha abruvan ।ayam parvaṇi vegena yajñiya aśvo apanīyate ॥1-39-8॥

translations.english: O son of the Kakutsthas, when the magnanimous king Sagara's sacrificial horse was stolen away, all the high priests addressing the performer of the sacrifice said:
